allocation_rules: Verify the current calendar title, time, ward, and confirmed status for every procedure-linked request.
Rank current requests by clinical priority and need-by time, then allocate the requested number of compatible units.
Within a compatible blood group, allocate the earliest-expiring available units first.
Use historical cancellations only when their documented cause remains active for the current case.
Ward location alone must not reduce current clinical demand or interpreter-like support capacity.
compatibility_scope: For this forecast, allocate only units whose labeled blood group exactly matches the patient request.
